tokens.v: Tilt it hard at the top of frame so the pour has already left the lip as one twisting ribbon of cloudy pale-yellow yuzu soda, carbonation threading it with fine bubbles and a citrus haze in the liquid, landing in crushed ice and throwing a crown of droplets. 100mm at f/4, camera low and off-axis, the arc running corner to corner. Take the backdrop to a saturated cobalt so the flash rim cuts the matte body cold. Out-of-focus ice shards cross the bottom edge, cut by the left edge. FERRO & SONS sits small inside the green stripe, the specular breaking across its middle letters, condensation standing proud over the ink.
